subject.name: RF and Microwave Communication
subject.source: Syllabus/Diploma_Full_Collection_1/Marwadi_Official_Diploma_Collector/Marwadi_Diploma_Syllabus_Collection/Verified_Syllabi/Diploma Information and Communication Technology/Semester_Unspecified/09CT0604 - RF and Microwave Communications (.pdf

content: History of Microwaves, Microwave frequency bands, General applications
of Microwaves, Advantages of Microwaves, Microwave Propagation
Concept of Mode, Characteristics of TEM, TE and TM Modes, Losses
associated with microwave transmission, Concept of Impedance in
Microwave transmission

chapters.chapter_name: Analysis of Microwave Transmission Lines and Waveguides
content: Transmission line equations & solutions, reflection and transmission
coefficient, standing wave and standing wave ratio, line impedance and
admittance, impedance matching, using stub line, skin effect, application of
smith chart in solving transmission line problems, Introduction to strip lines
Micro strip lines, Rectangular and circular waveguides
Equivalent voltages and currents for non-TEM lines, Network parameters
for microwave circuits, Scattering Parameters

chapters.chapter_name: Passive and Active RF and microwave Devices
content: Microwave Passive components: Directional Coupler, Power Divider
Magic Tee, Hybrid ring, Wave-guide Corners, Bends, Twists, Attenuator
Circulator, Isolator and Resonator
Microwave Active components: Tunnel diode, Varactor diodes, Step
recovery diodes, Schottky Barrier diodes, PIN diodes, Gunn Diodes
IMPATT and TRAPATT diodes, Parametric Amplifiers, Microwave
Transistors, Microwave oscillators and Mixers, Klystron, Magnetron
Measurement:
Wavelength
VSWR
Attenuation and ‘Q’, Microwave Radiation Hazards: type and
protection from hazards
